note: output_payload filled from the kernel itself; golden_hash filled by node golden-parity.test.mjs --update. Vectors cover: a covered EMT disclosure that meets the declared segregation minimum; a shortfall carrying an ineligible component and a concentration breach, both listed and neither dropped; a cadence window with two named unpublished periods; the zero-tokens-in-circulation finite gate; the empty-reserve finite gate; an asset-referenced token with no declared minimum, which raises judgment_required instead of applying the e-money-token 30%; and a caller-declared minimum that overrides the e-money-token default.

vectors.name: emt-covered-segregation-met
vectors.description: E-money token, reserve covers circulation, 40% of the reserve segregated against the e-money-token default minimum of 30% (applied only because the caller declared none), every component inside the declared eligible classes and inside the declared limits, monthly cadence met.

sign_off.note: Where a named human attests this check, the dual-control certification surface is the one to use. This kernel emits the receipt and evaluates no threshold of its own.

rationale: Reserve total of 512500000.00 checked against 500000000.00 of tokens in circulation.
The reserve carries 3 declared components across 3 asset classes.
Every component sits inside the declared eligible asset classes.
No declared concentration limit is exceeded.
Segregated proportion is 40.00% against a minimum of 30% (the e-money-token default, applied only because the caller declared nothing).
Every component sits with a custodian type the caller declared acceptable.
Every interval between publications is within the declared 31-day cadence.
Every verdict above is against the rules supplied with this run. It is not a determination that the issuer complies, not legal advice, and not a submission.

vectors.name: art-no-declared-minimum-judgment-required

judgment_required.reason: One or more declared rules were absent, so the corresponding check was not performed. An absent rule is reported as unresolved, never defaulted into a pass.
